name: Matriarche des serments
description: A lean muscular mature female chief with pale grey marbled skin, broad anatomical mandibles, dark amber eyes and long black dreads gathered low with flat bronze clasps. Black ceremonial robe split over wrapped dark trousers, broad ivory chest plaque and a crimson waist sash with hanging discs. Holds a straight short bronze oath rod angled close across her torso. Fully covered adult practical clothing, no sexual emphasis.
